company.name: Altibbi
company.shortDescription: Altibbi is the Largest Digital Health platform in the Arab World, including 1.5M pages of medical content and a 24/7 telehealth service.
company.description: Altibbi is a digital healthcare platform that provides online medical services and health information. It connects users with licensed doctors for medical consultations. The platform allows users to ask health-related questions and receive professional answers. It offers telemedicine services through text, voice, and video consultations.

productsAndServices.description: A digital healthcare service connecting patients with licensed doctors through on-demand voice calls and text chats, including 24/7 access and subscription-based consultations.
productsAndServices.name: Altibbi Telehealth Consultations (الاستشارات الطبية عن بُعد)

productsAndServices.description: An Arabic medical information platform containing articles, disease and symptom references, medical terminology, health news, videos, and answers to common health questions.
productsAndServices.name: Altibbi Medical Content Platform (منصة الطبي للمحتوى الطبي)

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered health information assistant that helps users ask medical questions, explore health information, and receive preliminary guidance through a conversational interface.
productsAndServices.name: Sina AI Health Assistant (سينا، مستشارك الصحي الموثوق)

productsAndServices.description: A searchable directory for finding doctors, hospitals, clinics, laboratories, pharmacies, and other healthcare providers by specialty, location, and provider type.
productsAndServices.name: Medical Directory and Healthcare Provider Search (الدليل الطبي)

productsAndServices.description: A question-and-answer service where users submit health questions and receive responses from Altibbi doctors or medical staff, with free and paid consultation pathways.
productsAndServices.name: Medical Questions and Answers (الأسئلة والإجابات الطبية)

productsAndServices.description: A searchable database of medicines and treatments with information on uses, active ingredients, side effects, contraindications, commercial names, and scientific names.
productsAndServices.name: Altibbi Drug Encyclopedia (موسوعة الطبي للأدوية)

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Altibbi combines Altibbi Drug Encyclopedia (موسوعة الطبي للأدوية) with Sina AI Health Assistant (سينا، مستشارك الصحي الموثوق).
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $44,000,000, or 83.81% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,436,828 to $193,009,171, a 20.45x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 64 (-16 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Vezeeta, Yalla Doc, Shezlong.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
